buyer_added_terms.text: Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS :- 1.The firms should submit their offer as per the Terms and Condition for HIRING OF 15 NOS. OF PRIVAT E SECURITY GUARDS AS REPLACEMENT OF DURWANS. AS PER SCOPE OF WORK ANNEXURE-A. e nclosed in Bid Document. 2. Other Terms:- The seller has to comply and execute the work as per scope of work attached al ong with bid. The Seller has to comply and execute the Service Work General Terms and condi tions of the Contract. 3. Firm to provide services as per scope of work (attached along with bid).Firm to comply scope of work an d to forward copy of scope of work (soft copy) duly signed and stamp of their company along with the GeM bid documents. 4. The Bid will also be governed by GeM GTC (General Terms & Conditions). 5. Firm to comply for payment of Bonus as per the DGR Guide lines and Payment of Bonus act 1965 (as am ended time to time). 6. In case 2 or more firms are lowest bidder then Supply Order will be awarded to senior most sponsored a gencies / private company as indicated in the sponsorship letter given by Joint Director of Directorate of re settlement Zone (S), head quarter southern commands (Army), Pune. 7. As per Office Memorandum No. 28(3)/2012-D(Res-I) dated 09.07.2012 issued by Govt. of India, Ministry of Defence (Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare) clause No. 22 “Earnest Money Deposit/Contract Perfor mance Guarantee (CPG)/Bank Guarantee. “DGR sponsored E SM are not required to deposit Earnest Money Deposit (EMD). However depending on the nature of service being provided a DGR sponsored ESM may be asked to deposit CPG or Bank Guarantee up to a maximum limit not exceeding 10 percent of one month’s wage bill. The CPG will be deducted from the ESMs Monthly services changes in installments as m utually agreed by the ESM and the Principal Employer”. Hence DGR sponsored firms may be exempted fro m payment of EMD. However the firms may be asked to deposit CPG or Bank Guarantee @ 10 percent of O ne month’s wage bill in the favor of AVNL, Avadi. 8. Payment will be made on monthly basis against bill supported by wage/muster roll/copy of statement of bank account showing Online payment duly signed & witnessed by concern ed HOS, JCC duly signed fro m HOS & DO and submission of proof of payment of EPF, ESIC e tc. to the PSG’s. Firm has to submit copy o f PF statement of individual labour to verify whet her PF as claimed is deposited in their account along with the bill. The firm has to claim payment on monthly basis. Amendment to supply order for revised rates inti mated by DGR will be done. No separate TPC will be held for the same. 9. The proprietor/ Director of the agency/ company awarded to the Contract should produce the following i n person at the time of signing of the Contract, the principal Employer will ve rify the same:- a) Copy of the DGR sponsorship letter. b) Original copy of DGR Empanelment certificate (with photograph and signature of proprietor /director).

c) PSARA License for the State of operation of the Security Agency d) All other documents as stipulated in the tender document. 10.The offers of only Six DGR sponsored firms with vendor qualification criteria and other terms and conditions along with standard terms and conditions as above will be technically accepted. Offer of any other firms will not be technically accepted. 11.The price bid format will be as per DGR Revised rates w.e.f 01.04.2026 which is enclosed in separate ex cel format along with bid. The firm has to quote the rates as per DGR rates only. . 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
